records.title: AstronautBench: Measuring Agent Self-Improvement Across Episodes Through Knowledge, Evidence, and Progress
records.claim: Task progress, world knowledge and evidence support do not move together, so no single measure shows whether an agent is improving across episodes.

method_and_setup.method: Three-view benchmark (progress, QA correctness, evidence support) judged by two LLM judges from different families.
method_and_setup.setup: Outer Wilds game, eight-episode baselines with GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Argon planners.

results.measures: GPT-6.1 Sol agent's correct answers as share of all questions
share of correct answers at episode 8 supported by cited evidence

records.change_for_agents: Score memory-carryover agents on whether each answer cites evidence they actually observed, not just on answer accuracy.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Gives a way to check that an agent's memory carryover is real learning, not unsupported correct answers; useful for evaluating Mitamaton's cross-session memory.

records.title: Self-Evolving Beyond Human-Crafted Experience for EDA Scripting
records.claim: An execution-grounded harness with governed self-evolution can match or beat human-crafted experience for EDA scripting.

method_and_setup.method: Task-level harness with API retrieval, sandbox execution and static checking, plus a three-tier memory store governed by anchoring, filtering, rollback and anti-leakage retrieval.
method_and_setup.setup: 158-task EDA-Eval-PyAether benchmark and a harder instance-disjoint test set across five LLM backbones.

results.measures: full harness with self-evolution disabled on EDA-Eval-PyAether
self-evolution vs human-crafted-experience baseline on the instance-disjoint set

records.change_for_agents: Gate any agent-written memory entry behind a held-out replay and rollback before it is retrievable.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: The governance gates (ground-truth anchoring, disconfirmation filtering, held-out rollback) are a concrete template for letting an agent write its own skills/memory without drift.

records.title: Keep the Process, Change the Supplier: Runtime Governance for Tool-Using AI Agents
records.claim: A control plane that records uncertain supplier outcomes and persists state avoids cross-supplier duplicate effects that retry-all causes.

method_and_setup.method: Execution boundary mediating capability calls with persistent runtime state and supplier routing.
method_and_setup.setup: Scripted requests and synthetic suppliers; no language model or agent evaluated.

results.measures: median latency, best-score vs pinned routing at 128 suppliers

records.limits: They do not establish improved agent task success, prompt-injection resistance, or real-vendor model portability.
records.change_for_agents: Record 'unknown outcome' for tool calls whose reply was lost and never blindly retry them across suppliers.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Retry-all duplicates effects after a lost reply; an idempotent, record-keeping tool boundary is directly relevant to an iOS day-admin agent that books or sends things.

records.title: Run One, Get Two: Near-Free Streaming Safety Checks for Local LLMs
records.claim: Streaming safety checks for local LLMs can match a dedicated guard model at a small fraction of its cost.

method_and_setup.method: Second model decoded as an extra batch row sharing weights and KV cache with dual-row kernels.
method_and_setup.setup: Qwen3-0.6B generator evaluated on 17 benchmarks.

records.change_for_agents: Run a safety guard as a co-decoded row on the local model rather than a separate guard model.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Shows a guard for on-device assistants can cost under 4% latency instead of doubling it.

records.title: MixFold: Sub-4-Bit Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Output-Channel Grouping on Mobile NPUs
records.claim: Mixed 2/3-bit weights grouped to match NPU tiles decode faster and use less energy at similar accuracy.

method_and_setup.method: Executes 3-bit and symmetric 2-bit weights natively and assigns datatypes to output-channel groups aligned with matrix-unit tiles.
method_and_setup.setup: Qwen3 model family on the Qualcomm Hexagon NPU of a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, compared with the Hexagon backend.

records.change_for_agents: Pick quantization formats by what the target NPU executes natively, not by bit count alone.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: On-device decode speed and energy bound what an iOS-style personal agent can run locally; this is Android/Qualcomm, so it is a reference not a drop-in.

records.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Stateful Privacy Sniffing of LLM Agents via Behavioral Covert Channels in Web Interactions
records.claim: An agent's benign web navigation choices leak its private context, and content-level defenses do not stop it.

method_and_setup.method: Stateful hierarchical probing with a coarse-to-fine hypothesis tree; defense fixes acquisition budget and confines selection to a local snapshot.
method_and_setup.setup: Four agents, three LLM backbones, 500 StackExchange queries and 378 multi-turn iKAT dialogues.

records.change_for_agents: Fetch resources under a fixed budget independent of private context and choose from a local snapshot.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Browsing agents with memory leak context through behavior even when no content is sent; content filters do not catch it.

records.title: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?
records.claim: Current LLMs can make a strong first improvement to an agent but cannot yet turn feedback from an improved system into the next one.

method_and_setup.method: Researchers train and revise a model-harness pair under a 24-hour budget, scored on separate test tasks.
method_and_setup.setup: Five frontier researchers across five agentic domains.

results.value: more than four fifths of the gap
results.measures: gap to an instruction-tuned reference closed by the strongest researcher

records.limits: Co-evolution rarely succeeds on long-horizon coding.
records.change_for_agents: Treat harness and model changes as one search problem when automating agent improvement.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Measures whether a model can improve its own harness plus weights jointly; relevant to self-improving Claude Code-style stacks.

records.title: TOUMAII: A 4.5M-Pair Tool-Calling Preference Dataset and Its Source-Agnostic Generator
records.claim: A large tool-calling preference dataset enables DPO for tool use, with a source-agnostic generator.

method_and_setup.method: Mine naturally occurring model failure modes into DPO preference pairs.
method_and_setup.setup: Fine-tune a 3-billion-parameter model and compare with other tool-calling preference datasets.

results.measures: 3B model vs other high-quality tool-calling preference datasets

records.change_for_agents: Run DPO on matched correct/incorrect tool-call pairs after SFT for small tool-calling models.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Preference data for tool-call errors could tune a small local model for MCP-style tool use.

records.title: Who Grades the Agent? Privilege Separation for Coding-Agent Benchmarks
records.claim: A trusted grader holding the expected answers prevents an agent that takes over the test environment from forging a pass.

method_and_setup.method: Privilege separation framework separating test execution from judging.
method_and_setup.setup: Terminal-Bench and DeepSWE tasks converted; adversarial agents read grading code but not answers.

records.limits: The attempts that got through mostly reveal weaknesses in the original tasks' tests.
records.change_for_agents: Run tests in the agent sandbox but judge results in a separate trusted process holding the expected answers.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: If you grade agents (or let agents grade each other), keep the expected answers outside the agent's reach.

records.title: TEA-Bench-BR: Can Coding Agents Turn a Branching Clinical Specification into Correct Code?
records.claim: Open-weight coding agents can implement branching clinical specs, with the 31B far ahead of the 12B.

method_and_setup.method: Hidden-case benchmark with mutant killing and a contamination probe.
method_and_setup.setup: 144 tasks, 6,798 hidden cases, Gemma 4 12B and 31B agents.

results.measures: Gemma 4 31B solve rate at levels 1 to 3

records.change_for_agents: Test coding agents against hidden mutant-killing cases rather than visible examples.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Shows open-weight Gemma 4 31B as a capable coding agent and that spec language changes results; the domain is clinical, so only the open-model data point matters.

records.title: Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents' Capability Frontier
records.claim: Expanding the search world with evidence along the agent's frontier keeps improving where static task growth saturates.

method_and_setup.method: Policy diagnoses partially mastered task regions, grows tasks and evidence, and uses probe disagreement for RL or hint-guided demonstrations.
method_and_setup.setup: Nine multimodal search benchmarks at 9B and 27B.

records.change_for_agents: Grow training tasks together with their evidence so unreachable negatives do not penalize the policy.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Agent training recipes that penalize missing evidence as policy error waste signal; the idea of growing tasks with evidence is transferable.

records.title: From Acting to Learning: Experience Selection toward Continually Learning Agents
records.claim: Optimizer-aware gradient selection of experience beats random and high-NLL selection for continual agent learning.

method_and_setup.method: Nine experience selectors compared on two fixed pools.
method_and_setup.setup: 4B agent, eight initialization seeds, 128 development task groups.

results.measures: success in the two pools with gradient selection
gradient-minus-random and gradient-minus-high-NLL in the frozen replication

records.change_for_agents: Select which stored trajectories to train on by gradient utility rather than randomly.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Which logged trajectories to learn from matters; optimizer-aware gradient selection beats random and high-NLL.

records.title: HookEvo: A Framework for Coordinated Plugin Evolution on Hook-Enabled Agent Runtimes
records.claim: Coordinated edits to hook handlers and shared state improve a frozen small executor.

method_and_setup.method: Separate improver diagnoses traces and proposes candidate harnesses evaluated against the current one.
method_and_setup.setup: Frozen Qwen3-4B executor on ALFWorld, DBBench, WebShop, OSBench.

records.change_for_agents: Evolve hook handlers and the state they share together instead of prompt text alone.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Hook-level harness evolution (receipt, context, action check) maps onto Claude Code hooks and plugins.

records.title: Bel: Step-Level Policy Improvement of Visual Agents Without Training
records.claim: Judging each action where it acts improves frozen GUI and robot-pointing policies without training.

method_and_setup.method: Mark each candidate on its own image copy; act on another candidate only when greedy scores below a threshold and trails by a margin.
method_and_setup.setup: Recorded GUI steps on mobile, web, desktop; live AndroidWorld and MiniWoB++.

results.measures: on mobile, web and desktop screens for each of three policies

records.change_for_agents: Render each candidate tap onto the screenshot and score it visually before executing.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: A drop-in verifier for GUI agent candidate actions without training.

records.title: ProbeAgent: Principled Diagnosis of Agent Failures in Verifiable Environments
records.claim: Executable tests built from failed trajectories identify repeated error causes and shared failure modes.

method_and_setup.method: Build executable tests, explain failures, construct cause-preserving tasks and cluster.
method_and_setup.setup: 22 agent configurations over tasks from 10 benchmarks.

records.change_for_agents: Re-run the agent on variants preserving a suspected failure cause to confirm it recurs.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Failure-mode descriptions are a cheaper way to see what your agent keeps doing wrong.

records.title: Tracking and Limiting Unsupported Claim Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Provenance-Aware Framework
records.claim: Passing provenance with claims may limit unsupported detail accretion and drift between agents.

method_and_setup.method: Compare baseline and provenance-aware pipelines, homogeneous and heterogeneous.
method_and_setup.setup: Measures claim meaning change, detail accretion, semantic drift, provenance preservation; no numbers in the abstract.

records.change_for_agents: Attach support status, source and transmission history to every claim handed between agents.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Provenance fields on inter-agent messages are cheap to add to a multi-agent stack.

records.title: Contexture: Runtime Context Eviction for High-Throughput Agent Serving
records.claim: Superseded tool outputs make up most removable context, and evicting them raises serving throughput.

method_and_setup.method: Tool-operation tracing plus global KV pressure and prefix residency drives eviction without extra model calls.
method_and_setup.setup: Two models, two harnesses, two benchmarks; H100.

results.measures: recorded final-history tokens identified as removal candidates

records.change_for_agents: Evict tool outputs that later operations supersede, keeping full history outside the model context.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Directly relevant to context assembly and KV pressure for tool-heavy local agent runs.

records.title: Privacy Protection in Self-Evolving Personal Agents: Persistent Memory and Cross-Carrier Transfer
records.claim: Reader non-use does not establish cleanup of learned state, and missing lineage obscures descendants.

method_and_setup.method: Survey and worked scenarios following one private fact through booking, learning and withdrawal.
method_and_setup.setup: Screened corpus plus diagnostic experiments on label protection and memory deletion.

records.change_for_agents: Track lineage for each private memory so withdrawal can reach derived skills and summaries.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Covers deletion of learned state and skills that inherit private data, a gap in memory design for a personal agent.

records.title: Exercised, Rarely Recovered: What Public Reports Say About Recovery in 50 AI Agent Harnesses and Runtimes
records.claim: Recovery is exercised almost everywhere but rarely fully succeeds in real use.

method_and_setup.method: Graded public evidence on eight recovery mechanisms under a frozen protocol with two blind coding passes.
method_and_setup.setup: 50 harnesses and runtimes.

results.measures: of 128 real-use reports describe full recovery

records.limits: Based on public reports, not controlled runs.
records.change_for_agents: Test checkpoint/resume and rollback in your harness with deliberate failures before relying on them.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Real-world checkpoint/resume and rollback rarely work; design your own recovery rather than trust it.

records.title: Epistemic Guard: Out-of-Process MCP Receipt Proxying, Post-Turn Prose Supervision, and Provenance-Gated Memory for Tool-Using Autonomous Agents
records.claim: An out-of-process MCP receipt proxy can verify tool claims and gate memory writes on CPU with no GPU.

method_and_setup.method: Ed25519 receipts, RFC 6962 Merkle logs, OpenVINO INT8 encoders and SQLite write gating.
method_and_setup.setup: Conformance suites, 250 frozen benchmark traces and 60 live mcp-proxy traces.

results.measures: warm median CPU latency on N=250 traces

records.change_for_agents: Route MCP calls through an out-of-process proxy that signs receipts and checks agent prose against them.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Directly targets MCP agents: stops narrated side effects that never ran and unverified prose entering durable memory.

records.title: Do Senior Agents Do Their Job? Measuring Role Integrity in How LLM Agents Use Subordinate Material
records.claim: Senior agents often follow majority reviews and drop subordinate limitations rather than doing their role.

method_and_setup.method: Behavioral benchmark perturbing subordinate material, rule-based checks plus a calibrated LLM judge.
method_and_setup.setup: Eight LLMs and over 12,000 agentic episodes.

results.measures: follow a majority of generic reviews

records.change_for_agents: Have orchestrators verify subagent claims and carry their limitations forward explicitly.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Orchestrator agents often just aggregate subagent reports; this quantifies it.

records.title: Correct Precedents Induce Policy Violations in On-Device LLM Agents
records.claim: A correct earlier decision in session history can lead an on-device agent to violate policy on the next item.

method_and_setup.method: Paired Decision Distillation of a weakly affected teacher into a LoRA adapter.
method_and_setup.setup: 13 open-weight models from nine developers.

records.change_for_agents: Re-check each restricted item's status instead of letting prior in-session decisions carry over.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Directly about small local agents as the last check before irreversible actions on private data.

records.title: Learning When to Ask: Advisor-Aware Post-Training for SLM Agents
records.claim: Teaching an SLM when to ask for advice lifts success across domains with few advisor calls.

method_and_setup.method: Multi-stage post-training from policy rollouts supervised by environment outcome.
method_and_setup.setup: TextWorld, LiveCodeBench and GAIA vs an untrained harness baseline.

records.change_for_agents: Train small agents to call a stronger advisor only when uncertain.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Advisor-executor pattern for small local models calling a cloud model sparingly.

records.title: Belief-State Management Meets Rubric Rewards for Agentic Forecasting
records.claim: Folding context into compact belief states improves forecasting agents, even untrained.

method_and_setup.method: Fold tool plus five-dimensional outcome-blind rubric rewards; PPO and GRPO post-training of a 35B model.
method_and_setup.setup: ForecastBench, Polymarket-Sim and FutureX.

records.change_for_agents: Give long-running agents a fold tool that rewrites context into a belief state.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: The fold tool is a concrete context-compaction pattern for long-horizon agents.

records.title: Schema-Validated LLM Workflows: A Benchmark Protocol and Comparative Evaluation Across Six Python Implementations
records.claim: Schema validity and task quality are separable and vary by framework.

method_and_setup.method: Frozen-plan confirmatory evaluation with Holm-adjusted contrasts against an SDK reference.
method_and_setup.setup: Five business workflow tasks, six implementations, 5400-row primary matrix.

records.limits: Primary contrasts are system-configuration findings, not causal attributions to library features.
records.change_for_agents: Score task correctness separately from schema validity for structured outputs.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Valid JSON is not a correct answer; framework choice matters for structured output.

records.title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
records.claim: Refining the execution harness from observed evidence improves manipulation without model updates.

method_and_setup.method: Dual-agent Actor/Reflector with hierarchical memory and evidence-based reflection.
method_and_setup.setup: RoboTwin 2.0, RoboSPA, RMBench and real-world tasks.

results.measures: average real-world success across three tasks

records.change_for_agents: Separate short-term execution context from long-term experience and reflect on observed evidence.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Robotics, but the memory-plus-reflection harness loop is the same pattern as agent harness evolution.

records.title: VMSA: Video Memory Skill Agent for Long Video Understanding
records.claim: Combining structured memory with induced memory skills gives the best accuracy on week-long egocentric benchmarks.

method_and_setup.method: Three memory components and a skill library refined from successful trajectories.
method_and_setup.setup: Seven long-video QA benchmarks.

results.measures: improvement over the strongest baseline on Ego-R1 Bench

records.change_for_agents: Induce reusable retrieval skills from successful agent trajectories.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Skill induction from successful retrieval trajectories is a pattern for agent memory skills.

records.title: Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation
records.claim: Root-cause guidance makes harness search find fixes faster.

method_and_setup.method: RCA agent plus proposer agent optimize inference code around a frozen model.
method_and_setup.setup: Visual Genome and PSG with five model-dataset combinations.

results.measures: R@100 and mR@100 gains for the multimodal LLM

records.change_for_agents: Diagnose where the model fails before asking an agent to search harness edits.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Vision task, but a clean example of RCA-agent plus proposer agent harness search.

records.title: CodeReviewBench: An Automated Benchmark for Evaluating the Software Factory
records.claim: Developer acceptance of review suggestions provides a continuously refreshed benchmark for review bots.

method_and_setup.method: Mine daily GitHub event stream for acted-on versus ignored suggestions.
method_and_setup.setup: 500K+ judged PRs across 18 tools.

records.change_for_agents: Use acted-on suggestions as a free quality signal for code-review agents.
records.why_it_matters_for_justin: Live benchmark of review bots that refreshes as tools update.
